tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: Boys & Girls Clubs of America (in this chapter, the “corporation”) is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Place of Incorporation and Domicile.—
tree.text: The corporation is declared to be incorporated and domiciled in the District of Columbia.

tree.heading: Perpetual Existence.—
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided, the corporation has perpetual existence.
